notes.title: Helheim Update v1.02 - Bug Fixing + Privacy Settings
notes.notes:
The first patch is here!
Some bug fixed here and there and privacy settings added.

Here is the content of version 1.02:

- New: privacy settings to disable data tracking by unity via web (press the button in the bottom left corner of the screen in the main menu)

- Fixed: bugged doors on the incubator arenas that won’t open
- Fixed: Hella was moving in the wrong direction if the left stick was only slightly moved
- Fixed: blurred screen on resolutions higher than 1920x1080
- Fixed: vignetting and greyscale weren’t disappearing after player respawn
- Fixed: some parts of the level weren’t loading
- Fixed: wrong flamethrower timing after player respawn
- Fixed: wrong camera behaviour after player respawn
- Fixed: harbour navigation issues
- Fixed: Vlad rune effect was continuing after player respawn
- Fixed: wrong achievements unlock (Sailed, Gods Don’t Bleed, The Power Lies In The Sword)
